query: How do I make an HTTP API call from inside a JavaScript Code node in n8n? I need to call an external API with authentication.
expected_behavior: Recommend the HTTP Request node with a credential for an authenticated call: Code nodes can't read credentials, this.helpers.httpRequestWithAuthentication is deny-listed, and a token written into code is a secret in a text field
If the call must stay inside Code logic, explain this.helpers.httpRequest() (the bare $helpers global is undefined in the task-runner sandbox)
Show a complete example with method, url, headers, and await
Reference BUILTIN_FUNCTIONS.md for the complete API reference
If Code stays, mention the Why Code: note
notes: Authenticated API calls belong in the HTTP Request node with a credential (native-first + secrets rule). this.helpers.httpRequest() is the in-Code fallback; $helpers is undefined.
